findings.title: No alerting wired despite metrics and a tracked TODO (fixed)
findings.note: PR #95; rules + ntfy receiver rendered by compose.

findings.title: No distributed tracing / correlation to a collector
findings.note: OBS-P2-004 residual; request-id/trace-context exist but no OTLP exporter.
findings.impact: Cross-service debugging relies on logs only.
findings.recommendation: Add OTLP export + a collector, or document the decision.

findings.title: Error tracking (Sentry) is optional and admin error buffer is in-memory
findings.note: Sentry wired only when DSN set; admin buffer lost on restart.
findings.impact: Errors can go unrecorded in some environments.
findings.recommendation: Require a DSN in production and persist admin errors.

report:
Alerting is now wired
(Prometheus + Alertmanager + ntfy, PR #95). Distributed tracing and error
tracking remain optional/incomplete.
